name: vJASS (JassHelper)
description: Compiles vJASS in trigger texts (libraries, scopes, structs, Zinc, //! directives) into the map's JASS with JassHelper, which ships with the game (_retail_\x86_64\JassHelper). JassHelper is open source (zlib licence, by Víctor Hugo Soliz); it isn't copied, the installed program is called. Adds "vJASS Library" to the trigger editor's New menu (vJASS texts open in a code editor with a JassHelper check). A script language extension (service w3.scriptLanguages): other languages can be added the same way.

vjass.jassHelper.description: jasshelper.exe to use. Empty: the one in the game folder (game.installDir\_retail_\x86_64\JassHelper).

vjass.debug.description: Debug mode (--debug): keeps debug statements and adds checks, like the World Editor's JassHelper > Enable debug mode.

vjass.optimize.description: Optimizer (off: --nooptimize), like the World Editor's JassHelper > Enable optimizer.
